routes.legacy_customer_scan: GET /user_to_app?store_id=<id> (302; reverse proxy must route it to the backend)

options.APP_APK_URL: legacy; HTTPS; streamed after a one-time activation. Unset disables the staff installer.
options.MAIN_SITE_API_V2: legacy; POST {MAIN_SITE_API_V2}firebase-dynamic-link. Unset disables customer links.
options.POS_CUSTOMER_APP_ORIGINS: rewrite allowlist for redirect destinations (security decision)

redis.pos:staff_download:grant:{qrDigest}: JSON {grantId,operatorId,expiresAt}; EX to the end of the QR period
redis.pos:staff_download:operator:{operatorId}: same JSON; EX to the end of the QR period
redis.pos:staff_download:activated:{grantId}: activation operation id; SET NX; EX MPOS_DOWNLOAD_LINK_EXP
redis.pos:staff_download:consumed:{grantId}: download operation id; SET NX; EX MPOS_DOWNLOAD_LINK_EXP
redis.dynamic_short_link_s_id_{storeId}: legacy key shared with UserToApp; destination URL; EX 3600

durable: pos_to_app_logs(store_id, scanned_at) per scan, as legacy
